title: stomatanthes trigonus
intro: Stomatanthes trigonus, commonly known as Brazilian rosewood, is a plant species that belongs to the Asteraceae family. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its numerous health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Stomatanthes trigonus include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit analgesic and anti-tumor activities. The bioactive constituents of Stomatanthes trigonus include flavonoids, terpenoids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
